text:
Sam H: FYI - BrightCo (acct b-8742) reporting rows that should be soft-deleted are still showing up in search/exports. Customer says they set a custom retention of 90d and then deleted ~3400 objects yesterday; API returned 204 but objects still appear in search results.
Jess K: Can you paste the delete request and a quick repro? Also need which index/archive tier these objects live in.
Sam H: Repro steps from the customer (sanitized):\n```
curl -X DELETE \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXX' \n  'https://api.redwood.example/v1/objects?bucket=brightco&page=1&object_id=abc123'\n# response: 204 No Content
```
Then they ran search: `GET /v1/search?bucket=brightco&q=object_id:abc123` -> returns the doc metadata (status: archived, retention: 90d). They also attached an audit log snippet showing the delete call and a storage API ack.
Sam H: Attaching lines from our indexer log around the time (redacted):\n```
[2026-11-02T09:12:45Z] tombstone-processor: enqueue tombstone job batch=27 account=b-8742
[2026-11-02T09:12:46Z] tombstone-processor: put tombstone -> indexer queue OK
[2026-11-02T09:12:47Z] indexer-worker: failed to write tombstone to archive-index: DecryptFailed: kms:Decrypt error for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd
[2026-11-02T09:12:47Z] indexer-worker: pausing tombstone processing due to repeated KMS errors
```
Jess K: hm KMS DecryptFailed. Any recent KMS key rotations or HSM maintenance? Might explain the index write failures and why tombstone markers never propagated.
Mike R: I saw a scheduled KMS rotation for that key on 2026-11-02 09:00 UTC (rolled by automated key-rotator). There was an IAM policy change we pushed for a different service principal the same morning. Likely the indexer role lost decrypt permissions for that key for a short window.
Legal Team Bot: @channel Preservation requested by BrightCo legal — Do not purge these objects until confirmed. Please add preservation tag and notify legal.
Ops Oncall: Created preservation snapshot (preserve://b-8742/2026-11-02-0913) and set legal-hold flag on account. Also filed incident INC-20261102-08 and set priority=high.
Mike R: Proposed mitigation: 1) restore decrypt perms for indexer role (iam:Decrypt) 2) restart tombstone-processor (id: tp-34) 3) re-run tombstone backfill for account b-8742 (command below). If successful, tombstone markers will be written and search entries will be filtered by TTL background job.
Jess K: What's the exact backfill command? Can we run it with dry-run first and confirm no other accounts are affected?
Mike R: backfill steps:\n```
# dry-run: lists candidate objects that need tombstones
redwoodctl indexer tombstone-backfill --account b-8742 --dry-run --since 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z
# apply (after perms restored):
redwoodctl indexer tombstone-backfill --account b-8742 --apply --batch-size 500
```
Sam H: Customer asked for ETA and whether we can expedite actual purge. Legal hold is present so we cannot purge. We need to confirm tombstones are applied first, then legal can request export or longer hold. Customer is upset; offered to keep them informed every 30m.
Mike R: Estimated time: restore IAM perms (5-15m), restart processor (2m), run backfill (depends, ~30-90m for 3.4k objects). I'll own the fix. I'll also attach an extra retry loop in the processor to avoid pausing on 5xx transient KMS errors while we remediate.
Jess K: I told BrightCo we'll update in 30m. I'll capture the audittrail once tombstones applied and confirm search no longer returns those ids.
Ops Oncall: I've escalated to infra for immediate IAM rollback and flagged the KMS key to prevent further automated rotations until resolved.
Legal Team Bot: Confirmed receipt of preservation snapshot. Legal will wait for the audit artifact before lifting hold.
Sam H: Action items: Mike -> restore perms + run backfill; Ops -> block key rotation + monitor; Jess -> customer comms every 30m + verify search; Legal -> hold. I'll update thread with incident link and final audit artifact. :thumbsup:
Mike R: Starting perm restore now, will post logs and job IDs here once done.
Ops Oncall: KMS rotation blocked and IAM policy rolled back. Noted in INC-20261102-08.
Mike R: Tombstone backfill started (job id tb-20261102-001). Dry-run matched 3,427 objects. Applying now.
Mike R: Backfill apply finished. All tombstones written. Indexer logs show tombstones committed.
Sam H: Verified with quick search for a sample id — no longer returned in normal search. Will run full 3k check and attach CSV.
Jess K: Sent preliminary update to BrightCo with incident link and promise of final audit CSV once full verification completes.
Sam H: Final audit CSV attached, legal hold still in place until customer confirms transfer. Closing internal escalation when legal releases. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
